## CloudInBuzunar v1.0.11

This is the first stable public milestone of CloudInBuzunar: a personal cloud
and home-server stack designed to run on an Android phone through Termux.

### Highlights

- Personal file vaults, media library and expiring share links
- Local AI through `llama.cpp` and selectable Qwen2.5 profiles
- aria2 and Transmission download management
- Encrypted-at-rest messaging between server users
- Live CPU, RAM, storage, network, GPU, battery and temperature monitoring
- Root-aware Android process view and automatic thermal protection
- Automatic backups and portable, checksum-verified migration archives
- Native Android companion with outage alerts, motion detection and opt-in
  camera/audio monitoring
- Optional HTTPS reverse proxy and Vaultwarden service

### Android companion

Download `cloud-in-buzunar-monitor-1.0.11.apk` from the assets below and install
it manually on Android. The application must be paired with your own
CloudInBuzunar server before monitoring features become available. The release
also includes `SHA256SUMS.txt` for verifying the downloaded APK.

### Important notes

- This APK is intended for sideloading and is not distributed through Google
  Play.
- Camera and microphone access is opt-in and Android keeps its foreground
  notification and privacy indicators visible while capture is active.
- Keep administrator, monitoring and Vaultwarden endpoints behind HTTPS and a
  trusted LAN or private VPN.
- Root-only metrics and charging controls vary by device and kernel.
- The current web and Android interfaces are in Romanian. English localization
  is planned for a future update.

See the [README](https://github.com/clementinny/cloud-in-buzunar#readme) for the
feature tour and the [operations guide](https://github.com/clementinny/cloud-in-buzunar/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md)
for installation and maintenance.
